summary: The root كَيَّفَ (kayyafa) and its derivatives, used by Muslim theologians, mean to specify something by its quality. These terms were formed by analogy, not directly heard from ancient Arabs.
lane: 2 كَيَّفْتُهُ فَتَكَيَّفَ ذ , used by the Muslim theologians, (K, TA,) verbs derived from كَيْفَ , (TA,) [signifying I specified by the ascription of its quality and it became so specified, ] are formed in accordance with analogy, not heard from the Arabs. (K, * TA.)
